Changes in your situation

Getting a refund

Page Content

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Legal and administrative authority governs getting a refund of the following fees and charges:

  • visa application charges
  • sponsorship fees
  • nomination fees
  • citizenship application fees
  • pre-visa ballot application fees.

This authority outlines how and why we can grant a refund.

You pay a fee so we can assess and validate your visa or citizenship application. We will not refund these fees to you because:

  • your application, nomination or sponsorship was refused or unsuccessful, or
  • ​​there is a change of mind in pursuing the visa or citizenship application.

Important​

If you reverse or cancel a payment for your application, it may become invalid. You may incur a debt to the Commonwealth.

This may limit your ability to get another visa.

Refer to the following information for details about when we can refund, what our processing times are, and how to request a refund or a review of the refund decision.​ ​​​
